paragraphs: Zevulun ben Dan (identified by Hyman as Shmuel’s student): Kiddushin 30a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: In the William Davidson digital text of Kiddushin 30a, Shmuel names Zevulun ben Dan as an example in discussing instruction by a grandfather. That scalar does not explicitly call him Shmuel’s student; the parenthetical relationship is Hyman’s.

The saved Davidson Kiddushin30a scalar has Shmuel naming Zevulun ben Dan as an example of instruction by a grandfather. It does not explicitly call him Shmuel’s student; that parenthesis remains Hyman’s assertion. All names remain untitled as supplied.
